key_concepts: People choose activities based on weather conditions.
Windy weather suits activities like flying kites and playing with pinwheels.
Sunny weather suits outdoor activities like swimming, picnics, and drying clothes.
Rainy weather suits indoor activities and eating warm food.
Stormy weather can cause floods and landslides.
Very hot weather can cause dehydration.
Thunderstorms bring lightning that can hurt people.
Heavy rain makes roads slippery and driving unsafe.
During dangerous weather, stay indoors or in school.
During hot weather, drink lots of water.
During lightning, avoid using electrical things and listen to weather news.
